name: Adoration
overview: Adoration in Scripture is centered on wholehearted love and reverence for God, as Jesus commands loving the Lord with all heart, soul, and mind (Matthew 22:37). This devotion is expressed through humble submission, where every knee bows at the name of Jesus, acknowledging His authority over all creation (Philippians 2:10). Christ’s divine glory and redemptive work, having purified sins and now seated at God's right hand, reveal the worthy object of our worship (Hebrews 1:3). Ultimately, all creatures unite in giving blessing, honor, glory, and power to God and the Lamb, affirming their eternal supremacy and deserving of our adoration (Revelation 5:13).
